notes: Travel takes real time and money. Walking, the metro (05:30 to 00:30), buses (until 23:00) or a taxi (any time, slow and pricey at rush hour). The story plays the trip and moves the clock forward by the trip time, and fares come out of your wallet (your companions pay their own unless someone covers them).

Text someone to come over and they really decide: how much they trust you, what they're doing, how far away they are, whether they can afford the fare, and their mood. If they say yes they give an honest ETA, actually travel (you can watch them on the map), and turn up in the scene. If you've left by then, they text asking where you went, and they remember it.
